questions.question: How should RFC-0019 and RFC-0020 be closed?

options.label: Both Rejected (Recommended)
options.description: 0020: Phase 0 failed, no phases left. 0019: D5 design failed its own stop conditions; CI-lane motivation stays in ID-266's dossier. Status lines name the evidence.

options.label: 0020 Rejected, 0019 stays Draft
options.description: Keeps 0019 open as the umbrella for ID-266's CI lane. The RFC keeps describing a selector that won't ship.

options.label: Leave both Draft
options.description: Nothing changes in the status lines; only the RTD rendering gets fixed.

questions.question: What about RFC-0015, which is in force but not yet measured?

options.label: Stay Draft, BK-384 decides (Recommended)
options.description: Keeps the graduation gate the RFC set for itself. Nothing changes now.

options.label: Accept now
options.description: Matches what is already running, but skips BK-384's three-delivery measurement. BK-384 would then have to be re-scoped or closed.

questions.question: What should the same PR also fix?
Which opening sentence should replace the current one on the Research index? (The second sentence, 'The resulting documents are presented here…', stays.)

options.label: Evidence over assumption (Recommended)
options.description: "We decide on evidence, not assumption: an open question is investigated before it is answered, and what we found is recorded with how we found it." States the principle and why the records exist, with no list of topics.

options.label: Reasoning outlives decision
options.description: "A decision is only as durable as the reasoning behind it, so before we commit to a direction we investigate the question and keep the findings." Leads with why the records are kept.

options.label: Measure before we bind
options.description: "Before a choice binds the code or the process that builds it, we test it against evidence: measurements, prototypes, outside practice." Closest to the current text, but the colon brings back a short list.

questions.question: The RFC index opens the same narrow way: 'RFCs propose significant new features or changes…', but several RFCs are about process (0015, 0016, 0018 to 0020, 0022). Reword it in the same PR?

options.label: Yes, broaden it (Recommended)
options.description: For example: "RFCs propose a significant change, to the library or to how it is built, for discussion before it is decided." It's on the page this PR already fixes.

options.label: No, Research page only
